description: This is a unit test class for the BooleanValueValidator in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.headers package, testing validation logic for boolean header values.

classes.name: BooleanValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for BooleanValueValidator, verifying validation behavior, immutability, and handling of different boolean representations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the BooleanValueValidator instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the BooleanValueValidator class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Asserts that passing null as the header definition throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that a null value for header content throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: canValidateBoolean
methods.description: Verifies that the validator can validate Java boolean and Boolean types.

methods.name: acceptTrueCharSequence
methods.description: Test that the validator accepts 'true' as a valid boolean string.

methods.name: acceptFalseCharSequence
methods.description: Test that the validator accepts 'false' as a valid boolean string.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotBoolean
methods.description: Checks that the validator does not throw an exception for non-boolean header types.

methods.name: acceptInvalidCharSequence
methods.description: Verifies that an invalid boolean string throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException.
